02 / From bare surface to finished coverage

What goes into
the finished layer.

Spray foam is applied to the building surface, where it expands and cures into an insulating layer. Here’s what to discuss with Eric before your project begins.

01

Plan the coverage.

Review your building, dimensions and intended use. Confirm the foam type, thickness, surfaces and estimate for your project.

02

Prepare the space.

Agree on what needs to be moved or protected, surface preparation, ventilation and access. Keep occupants and other trades out of the application area.

03

Apply the foam.

The installer sprays the agreed surfaces using the product’s application requirements. Foam expands in place to follow the building’s contours.

04

Cure. Review. Return.

Allow for curing, ventilation and cleanup, then review the finished coverage. Eric will confirm when you can return based on the product and site conditions.

PROJECT BY PROJECT Foam selection, thickness and return-to-use timing depend on your building and the product used.
